about: Round RPG4: the RPG's numbers - gold, prices, rewards, shop stock. EVERY value here is a placeholder (Claude's estimate, 12 Oct 2026); the plan leaves prices, the share of gold lost and reward rates open, to be tuned while Karl plays the slice. Karl's own numbers so far: basic lands are bought, 1 gold each (13 Oct, Round RPG7); a lost duel takes a share of the gold you carry by kind of fight, regular 5%, dungeon 10%, boss 20%, never more than 20% (3 Nov, Round GOLD1: loss_gold_share - one number still means the same share for every kind; the foe you lost to holds the gold until you beat it). Round PACK1 (3 Nov 2026): jumpstart_price, premium_pack_price, bundle_price (three plain packs at once) and jumpstart_stock (theme packs a shop has) are Claude's placeholders until prog-tune; jumpstart_price was raised from 60 to 90 because a Brackwater theme pack's cards sell back for 68.5 gold on average (claude/PACK1_2026-11-03.md section 4). rpg/economy.py checks this file when it is read and names any key it can't use.
